relationship: The adapter preserves pinned combined-options precedence, explicit-property suppression of inherited defaults and all-hooks-included lifecycle. Native context creation and versioned canonical scope ownership are independent implementations.
changes: Apply only implemented native context options; reject unsupported options explicitly.
Use one canonical-core scope instead of upstream client instrumentation.
Capture options and timeouts at context invocation; restore scope on runner teardown.
Keep the boundary private to canonical core; preserve mixed ESM/CommonJS identity.
